LanguageData.CC_Rooms_SizesTip: Comes in these sizes and kinds: {0}. Pick one in the planner.
LanguageData.CC_Style_Spartan_Tip: Only the essentials: the beds, benches and tables the room is for, and a light. No floor unless the room has to stay clean. Cheap and quick to build.
LanguageData.CC_Style_Comfortable_Tip: The standard furnishing: the essentials plus bedside tables, dressers, plant pots and a floor.
LanguageData.CC_Style_Lavish_Tip: Everything in comfortable, plus extra decor where the room has space: more plant pots along the walls, pedestals for sculptures and a rug where your mods provide them, and carpet or fine stone tiles. Hospitals and kitchens keep their sterile floor.
LanguageData.CC_Template_ForLowTech: This is a room for a tribal or medieval colony. Set the colony's era in the mod settings to plan it anyway.
LanguageData.CC_Template_ForIndustrial: This room needs an industrial colony.
LanguageData.CC_Planner_UseWhatWeHave_Tip:
Forget the materials picked for this room and choose each one from the stock again: something the colony has enough of, stone blocks first, then wood, bone (anything but walls) and steel. Silver, gold, plasteel, uranium and jade only when nothing else will do.
Green: enough with some to spare. Amber: only just enough. Red: not enough.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Block_CantTurn: {0} can only be built facing north, and it doesn't fit that way here.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Block_NoWallForLamp: There's no free stretch of wall left here for the {0} to hang on.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Block_LampCell: Something else is planned on the spot where the {0} would hang.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Block_LampTaken: Something already hangs on that side of the wall, where the {0} would go.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Dark_DetailWall: Colonists in the dark work slower and get a mood penalty. {0} on a wall of each would fix it.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Warn_Rearranged: Some furniture was turned or left out, so every piece can be reached and used.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Warn_SkipWalls: {0} wall segment(s) would stand on water, marsh or mud. They'll be left out, so the wall has a gap there.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Warn_SkipDoor: The door's spot is on water, marsh or mud, so the room goes down without a door. Move the door to firm ground to keep it.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Warn_SkipInside: {0} cell(s) inside are deep water or other ground nothing can stand on. They stay as they are.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Warn_FurnitureGround: {0} piece(s) of furniture would stand on ground that can't hold them and will be left out.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_Mouse_Skips: Part of it is on water, marsh or mud and will be left out.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_SkippedGround: Left out on water, marsh or mud: {0}.
LanguageData.CC_Upgrade_Tip: Furnish a room you've already built with this plan: hover the room and click it. Only the furniture it doesn't have yet is planned, and the floor goes only on bare ground. The plan turns to the wall with the room's door.
LanguageData.CC_Upgrade_Pick: Click a built room to furnish it from the {0} plan. Only what's missing is planned.
LanguageData.CC_Upgrade_TooSmall: The room is {0}x{1} inside; this plan needs {2}x{3}. Try a smaller size.
LanguageData.CC_Upgrade_InWall: {0} goes into the wall. Build it by hand.
LanguageData.CC_Upgrade_Nothing: This room already has everything the plan would add.
LanguageData.CC_Upgrade_Done: Furnished the room from the {0} plan: {1} piece(s) of furniture planned, {2} already there.
LanguageData.CC_Yours_SaveDesc: Click a room you've built to keep it as a plan of your own. It's saved with the mod's settings, so you can plan it in every game.
LanguageData.CC_Yours_SaveButton: Save a built room as a plan
LanguageData.CC_Yours_PickRoom: Click a built room to save it as a plan. It has to be an enclosed rectangle with a door.
LanguageData.CC_Yours_NeedName: Give the plan a name first.
LanguageData.CC_Yours_Saved: Saved "{0}" ({1}x{2}, {3} piece(s) of furniture). Find it under Your rooms.
LanguageData.CC_Yours_DeleteConfirm: Delete the room plan "{0}"? This can't be undone.
LanguageData.CC_Yours_NotARoom: Pick an enclosed room, not the outdoors or a doorway.
LanguageData.CC_Yours_NotRectangle: Only rectangular rooms can be saved.
LanguageData.CC_Yours_TooBig: Rooms up to {0} cells on a side can be saved.
LanguageData.CC_Yours_NoDoor: The room needs a door in one of its walls (not in a corner).
LanguageData.CC_Settings_BuildMenuCounts: Show material counts in build menus
LanguageData.CC_Settings_BuildMenuCounts_Tip: When you pick a material for a wall, door or piece of furniture in the game's build menu, each material shows how much the colony has: stored (stockpiles and shelves), lying around (not forbidden, not in storage), and how many you could build with it.
LanguageData.CC_BuildPrio_ButtonDesc:
How soon this gets built. Builders take on nothing at a level while something at a higher one can go ahead: its materials are on the map and someone here has the skill for it. Anything that can't go ahead doesn't hold the rest up.
Click to step through normal, high, urgent and low for everything selected; right-click to pick one.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_BuildPriorities_Tip: A button on each of the colony's blueprints and frames sets how soon it gets built: low, normal, high or urgent. Builders finish what can go ahead at the highest level first. A job you give by hand is always taken.
